title: S.R.O. 1300(I)/2018 — Persons to whom redeemable capital may be issued (section 66)

source.name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan

verification.note: Official Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan PDF shown as published updated to 25 October 2018. Check against the Gazette before quoting.

summary: Made under section 510 read with section 66: notifies the persons to whom an instrument in the nature of redeemable capital may be issued (securities brokers; funds and trusts as defined in the Employees Contributory Funds Regulations, 2018; companies and bodies corporate), with a proviso for Government debt securities.
